full_judgment: 7. Annexures C and C1 are the registered purchased deeds dated 10-1-1981 of the petitioner and her husband. The petitioner has also filed approval of RAJUK dated 7-10-1991 as to the building plan by letter dated 17-5-1993 vide Annexure E, Annexure E1 is the sanction letter of the Arab Bangladesh Bank about house building loan of the petitioner. Annexure E4 is the SA Map relating to the case plot Nos. 203 and 204, Annexure E5 is the CS Map relating to plot Nos. 203 and 204 shown as 563, 558 and 557, Annexure E6 is the RS Naksha, Annexure F is the porch a dated 5-10-1981 and Annexure F1 is the rent receipt for the years 1407 and for the years 1392, 1393 and 1394, Annexure F2 is the RS Khatian of the original owners from whom the petitioner's vendor Azhar Hossain purchased the land by two deeds, Annexure F3 is the CS Khatian of Dilu Bepary, Annexure F4 is the DCR of the vendor Azhar Hossain dated 15-1-1988. Annexure F5 is the porcha of the vendor, Azhar Hossain showing his land as 0.0785, Annexure F6 is the assessment sheet of the Dhaka City Corporation, Annexure 7 is the assessment by Dhaka Corporation, Annexure F8 is the notice of the Dhaka City Corporation dated 28-9-1993. Annexure F9 is the WASA bill, Annexure F10 is the wasa connection order dated 10-3-1993, Annexure F11 is the electric supply connection and Annexure G is the summary sheet of compensation assessment on requisition of land and Gazette showing acquisition of land in LA Case Nos. 15 and 16 of 1959-60 showing part acquisition of part of plot Nos. 203 and 204. The respondents however have not filed any document in support of his contention.
